products.name: ABCDE-2200 Five-Layer Co-extrusion Blown Film Line
products.seoTitle: ABCDE-2200 5-Layer Co-Extrusion Blown Film Machine | Ashal Innomach
products.metaDescription: High-capacity ABCDE-2200 five-layer blown film line with 400 kg/h max output and 2200 mm film width for high-barrier industrial packaging.

specs.Compatible Resins: LDPE, LLDPE, HDPE, MLLDPE, Barrier Resins
specs.Control System: PLC with central touchscreen & automatic thickness control

features: Internal Bubble Cooling (IBC) system for high-speed stability
Gravimetric dosing and automatic gauge control
Low-shear screw design minimizing polymer degradation

faqs.question: What barrier materials can the ABCDE-2200 5-layer blown film line process?
faqs.answer: The ABCDE-2200 is engineered to process EVOH and Polyamide (PA/Nylon) barrier resins alongside LDPE, LLDPE, HDPE, and MLLDPE using compatible tie-layer adhesive resins for high-barrier food and chemical packaging.

faqs.question: What is the maximum throughput capacity of the ABCDE-2200 line?
faqs.answer: The line achieves a maximum output of up to 400 kg/h, depending on film gauge, width, and polymer formulation, supported by an internal bubble cooling (IBC) system.

faqs.question: How does the automatic gauge control system operate?
faqs.answer: The line features non-contact capacitive or beta-ray thickness measurement sensors linked to a high-precision segmented thermal air ring, regulating gauge variation to within ±3%.

products.name: ABA Three-Layer Co-Extrusion Blown Film Line (1000 / 1200 / 1500)
products.seoTitle: ABA 3-Layer Blown Film Extruder (1000-1500mm) | Ashal Innomach
products.metaDescription: Cost-efficient ABA 3-layer co-extrusion line using calcium carbonate (CaCO3) or recycled core material to reduce production costs by up to 30%.
features: Up to 50% recycled material or CaCO3 filler in the middle B-layer
High mechanical tensile and dart-impact film strength
Precision spiral die head ensuring uniform melt distribution

faqs.question: How much raw material cost can an ABA 3-layer line save compared to single layer?
faqs.answer: By utilizing up to 50–70% recycled PE resins or calcium carbonate (CaCO3) masterbatch in the middle B-layer while maintaining virgin resin in the outer A-layers, manufacturers typically reduce overall polymer costs by 20% to 35%.

faqs.question: Does using recycled plastic in the middle B-layer affect printability?
faqs.answer: No. Because the outer A-layers encapsulate the core layer with 100% virgin polymer, the surface gloss, corona treatment retention, and flexographic printability remain high quality.

faqs.question: What is the maximum cycle speed across multiple lanes?

products.seoTitle: AI-6C 6-Color CI Flexo Printing Machine (260 m/min) | Ashal Innomach

specs.Substrates: PE, PP, PET, BOPP, Paper, Non-woven

features: Central Impression (CI) drum eliminating film stretching during high-speed printing

faqs.question: Why is a Central Impression (CI) drum superior for printing extensible plastic films?
faqs.answer: The single high-precision central steel drum locks the film against its surface during all 6 color stations, preventing film elongation and maintaining color registration within ±0.1mm at speeds up to 260 m/min.

faqs.question: What substrates are compatible with the AI-6C flexo press?
faqs.answer: The AI-6C handles LDPE, HDPE, BOPP, PET, CPP, breathable films, barrier laminates, kraft paper, and non-woven fabrics.

products.seoTitle: CX Plastic Film Recycling & Pelletizing Line (99% Recovery) | Ashal Innomach
products.metaDescription: Integrated cutter-compactor recycling extruder line for PE and PP scrap film with 99% resin recovery and vacuum degassing.

specs.Suitable Scrap: Blown film edge trim, bag cutoffs, printed film waste

features: Direct feeding from film roll or scrap scrap without pre-shredding

faqs.question: Can printed scrap film be recycled without pre-washing?
faqs.answer: Yes. The CX line integrates dual-zone high-vacuum degassing to remove volatile printing ink vapors and moisture, producing bubble-free, high-density granules ready for immediate re-extrusion.
